observation: Three-round critique process (Round 1 REVISE, Round 2 REVISE, Round 3 APPROVED) systematically caught and forced resolution of critical issues before code shipped — two load-bearing gaps (test enumeration wrong/incomplete with 5 of 7 WorkPortfolio files unmentioned; R2 CTA copy adjacency failing /create bet/i regex) that would have broken tests in Phase 3.

Latent main breakage discovered during Phase 2 critique: U9 renamed empty-state testid create-bet-cta→portfolio-empty, then U11 rebaselined most references but missed R2's CTA block. R2's 5-test CTA suite was RED on main before AG2. Critic's empirical baseline verification (ran R2 against branch base) caught the hidden breakage.
TDD red phase caught empty-state frame invariant: new-bet-btn present even at zero bets (AC-4). Component test `new-bet-btn present even when NO bets (frame invariant)` proved before implementation.

Predicate extraction discipline: four pure functions (distinctStatusBuckets, distinctTeamIds, hasAnyRecordedOutcome, clearFilters) imported by both WorkPortfolio component AND test suite — single source of truth across all assertions. Zero module-vs-inline drift risk.

Architecture plan's Rule 1 (Layer integrity) was correct; the test enumeration error (CRITICAL-1) in Phase 2 Round 1 shows that intuitive assumptions about test file locations do not survive against actual grep. Plan must enumerate every affected test path, not rely on naming convention.

R2 CTA contract (CRITICAL-3) required the copy to be the exact string 'Create bet' to pass /create bet/i regex; 'Create your first bet' (from approved design) fails because the phrase 'your first' breaks adjacency required by Playwright's regex matching. Designer had written both docs before testing the regex; critique's empirical regex verification caught the mismatch.

Verdict zone-honesty contract pinned unambiguously in Phase 2 Round 3: verdict pills shown as an atomic ZONE on showVerdictFilter, not re-gated per-pill. All five verdict pills render identically once the zone shows. Zero ambiguity at implementation time.

Status-bucket folding consistency verified: distinctStatusBuckets (killed+completed→'completed') folds identically to filteredBets logic. The gate cannot show a status control the filter can't honour. Single helper prevents drift.

E2E screenshot path double-nested (e2e/screenshots → packages/web/packages/web/e2e/screenshots junk dir) — relative path combined with Playwright cwd already set to packages/web. Screenshots created and valid, but paths wrong. Requires fix commit to correct 5 path strings. Non-blocking because visual proof exists.

Stale verdict filter can survive zone hiding (user selects 'Refuted', outcomes later removed, zone hides but filter active, landing in filter-excluded-empty). Escape hatch ('Clear filters') exists. Edge case, noted for future, not a regression.

Architecture Plan Reconciliation (Phase 1) was load-bearing: none of the spec ACs required new schema/API/hooks. Status quo + honest gates on existing endpoints. Correctly identified as pure presentation. Zero mid-stream API surprises.

Test enumeration error in architecture plan (CC-007/CC-008 pattern recurring) — the plan named only 2 of 7 WorkPortfolio test files and got one path wrong. Pattern: architect writes test plan, assumes file locations from naming convention (WorkPortfolio.test.tsx), but codebase has split dirs (pages/__tests__/ vs __tests__/). Solution: architecture/SKILL.md Phase 1 reconciliation must include a 'find' command to verify exact test-file paths before finalizing the protected-tests list.
